# llms.txt — @vesk/lsp

> Machine reference for the Vesk LSP server. Verified against `packages/lsp/src/server.ts` at commit 5b94b66.

## Package identity

- `name`: `@vesk/lsp`, `version`: 0.1.0, ESM, `type: module`, Node >= 20.
- `main`: `./dist/server.js`, `bin`: `vesk-lsp` → `./dist/server.js`.
- Deps: `@vesk/compiler ^0.1.0`, `vscode-languageserver ^9.0.0`, `vscode-languageserver-textdocument ^1.0.0`.

## Project index (in-memory)

```ts
interface ProjectFile {
  uri: string;
  path: string;
  exports: ExportInfo[];
  components: ComponentInfo[];
  declarations: DeclInfo[];
  lastModified: number;
}
interface ProjectIndex {
  workspaceRoot: string;
  appDir: string | null;
  baseUrl: string;
  pathAliases: PathAlias[];
  files: Map<string, ProjectFile>;
  componentSources: Map<string, string>;
  tailwindClasses: Set<string>;
}
```

Built on `initialize` via `scanProject(workspaceRoot)` (uses compiler `scanRoutes`, `scanComponents`, `collectSources`). Incrementally updated via `onDidChangeWatchedFiles` (create/delete only; changes trigger `validateDocument` through `onDidChangeContent`).

## Full capability inventory (from `onInitialize`)

```ts
{
  textDocumentSync: TextDocumentSyncKind.Incremental,
  completionProvider: {
    triggerCharacters: ['<','{','/','.',' ','"',"'",'`','c','e','i','l','f','w','t','s','&',':','-'],
    resolveProvider: true,
  },
  hoverProvider: true,
  documentSymbolProvider: true,
  workspaceSymbolProvider: true,
  semanticTokensProvider: {
    legend: {
      tokenTypes: ['component','reactive','keyword','function','variable','property','type','event'],
      tokenModifiers: ['declaration','definition','readonly','async'],
    },
    full: true,
  },
  foldingRangeProvider: true,
  definitionProvider: true,
  referencesProvider: true,
  renameProvider: { prepareProvider: true },
  documentHighlightProvider: true,
  signatureHelpProvider: { triggerCharacters: ['(', ','] },
  documentFormattingProvider: true,
  documentRangeFormattingProvider: true,
  documentOnTypeFormattingProvider: {
    firstTriggerCharacter: '>',
    moreTriggerCharacter: ['/', '\n'],
  },
  colorProvider: true,
  documentLinkProvider: { resolveProvider: false },
  codeActionProvider: { codeActionKinds: [CodeActionKind.QuickFix] },
  workspace: {
    fileOperations: {
      didCreate: { filters: [{ pattern: { glob: '**/*.{vsk,ts,tsx,js,jsx}' } }] },
      didDelete: { filters: [{ pattern: { glob: '**/*.{vsk,ts,tsx,js,jsx}' } }] },
    },
  },
}
```

## Handler inventory

| Handler | Registration | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `onInitialize` | `connection.onInitialize` | Scans workspace; returns capabilities. |
| `onDidChangeWatchedFiles` | `connection.onDidChangeWatchedFiles` | Re-indexes created/deleted files. |
| `onDidChangeContent` | `documents.onDidChangeContent` | Calls `validateDocument` → parse errors + Vesk diagnostics. |
| `onCompletion` | `connection.onCompletion` | Context-aware: imports, components, props, keywords, Tailwind classes. |
| `onCompletionResolve` | `connection.onCompletionResolve` | Adds detail/kind to completion items. |
| `onHover` | `connection.onHover` | Hover for components, tracked vars, imports. |
| `onDefinition` | `connection.onDefinition` | Go-to-def for components, imports, exports. |
| `onReferences` | `connection.onReferences` | Find references. |
| `onDocumentHighlight` | `connection.onDocumentHighlight` | Highlights occurrences. |
| `onPrepareRename` | `connection.onPrepareRename` | Validates rename range. |
| `onRenameRequest` | `connection.onRenameRequest` | Renames across project. |
| `onDocumentSymbol` | `connection.onDocumentSymbol` | Document symbols. |
| `onWorkspaceSymbol` | `connection.onWorkspaceSymbol` | Workspace symbol search. |
| `onFoldingRanges` | `connection.onFoldingRanges` | Folding ranges. |
| `onDocumentLinks` | `connection.onDocumentLinks` | Import path links. |
| `onSignatureHelp` | `connection.onSignatureHelp` | Signature help for calls + component props. |
| `onCodeAction` | `connection.onCodeAction` | Quick fixes (parse errors, undefined components). |
| `onDocumentFormatting` | `connection.onDocumentFormatting` | Formatting. |
| `onDocumentRangeFormatting` | `connection.onDocumentRangeFormatting` | Range formatting. |
| `onDocumentColor` | `connection.onDocumentColor` | Colors in `<style>` blocks (hex, rgb, rgba, hsl, named). |
| `onColorPresentation` | `connection.onColorPresentation` | Color format conversions. |
| `onDocumentOnTypeFormatting` | `connection.onDocumentOnTypeFormatting` | Auto-close JSX tags on `>`. |
| `semanticTokens.on` | `(connection.languages as any).semanticTokens.on` | Semantic token highlighting. |

## Cross-module coupling

- Depends on `@vesk/compiler` for parsing (`parse`), route/component scanning (`scanRoutes`, `scanComponents`, `collectSources`).
- Does not depend on `@vesk/runtime` directly (LSP is a build/editor tool).
- The bundled server (`scripts/build-lsp.js`) is consumed by `extension/vsk-vscode` and `extension/vsk-neovim`.

## Modification checklist

- **New LSP capability** → declare in `onInitialize` capabilities, implement handler, update `docs.md` and this file.
- **New Vesk syntax** → update `validateDocument`, `getVskComponents`, `parseExports`, `parseDeclarations` to recognize it; add completion/hover/definition support.
- **Bundle path change** → update `scripts/build-lsp.js` input path (currently hardcoded absolute path).
- **Editor extension consumer** → verify the bundled output still works with the VS Code / Neovim clients.
